description.describe_ch:
Calculus is a course provides basic training in mathematics. It involves the differentiation and the integration. These are used to solve problems via geometry and algebra. Calculus has a lot of
applications in many fields, such as science, engineering, economics and management. The materials in Analytic Geometry and Calculus I include the limits of functions, the derivatives, the integrals, the logarithmic  and exponential functions, and the inverse trigonometric functions

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: There will be two midterm exams. Each is worth 20% of the course grade.
One worksheet will be given in each session.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: Two Midterm Exams (20% each) , Final Exam (20%); Homework (20%) and Attendance and in class exercise(20%)
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: In-class assignments account for 30% of the course grade. One worksheet will be given in each class and is expected to be submitted to me by the end of the session. Late submissions will not be accepted.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1) Be on time for the lecture, if 20 minutes late for the lecture will be marked as absence for one hour. 
2) To concentrate in class and follow the lecture to finish the exercises in class and due on time in the assigned deadline. 
3) Do the homework regularly after class.  
4) Do your own homework ask questions in class or time break or in the consultation hours. 
5) You have to get Four stamps from TA or Teacher in this semester. (Every time you ask questions from TA or teacher, you will get a stamp)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Weekly review of class examples and worksheet problems is highly recommended. Missing a class will result in the loss of the corresponding worksheet credit.
強烈建議每週複習課堂例題和練習題。缺課將導致相應的練習題學分被扣除。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1) be honest in the tests. Anyone who violates the test regulations will be processed according to the FCU test regulations. 
2) You may contact me by email cyuhsu@o365.fcu.edu.tw or FCU ext. 6631 or ISTM office.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: Be on time for the lecture, if 20 minutes late for the lecture will be marked as absence for one hour.  To concentrate in class and follow the lecture to finish the exercises in class and due on time in the assigned deadline.  Do the homework regularly after class and be honest in the tests. Anyone who violates the test regulations will be processed according to the FCU test regulations.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Cheating on any exam is strictly prohibited. The use of calculators, phones, or any electronic devices is not allowed during exams. Group discussion of worksheet problems is encouraged.
嚴禁任何考試作弊。考試期間禁止使用計算機、手機或任何電子設備。鼓勵小組討論練習題。
